claim_boundary: Measurement protocol only; no envelope is production sizing and no runtime has earned a resource assignment yet.
semantic_acceptance_rule: Measured benchmark evidence must use mff.benchmark-semantic-profile.v1 structured load and measurement objects with canonical units, percentile/sample consistency, explicit applicability, failure/restart execution evidence, internally consistent error-rate arithmetic, and byte-bound raw evidence.
acceptance_rule: A component resource profile may be selected only from retained measurements under a declared load model, with headroom and failure/recovery behavior documented. A measured result must use the mff.runtime-benchmark-evidence.v1 schema under mff.benchmark-semantic-profile.v1 and bind the exact runtime key, sealed runtime release, immutable image digest, manifest, resource profile, target environment, offset-aware execution time, measurement toolchain, semantically structured load model, semantically structured required measurement set, and SHA-256 of retained raw evidence.
